subject.title: Feature Request: WhatsApp sticker send support

question: Which public WhatsApp sticker-send contract and encoding policy should OpenClaw support before implementation?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but action=sticker, an asSticker/sendAsSticker option, and automatic WebP detection have different user-facing compatibility and encoding tradeoffs.

options.title: Use explicit sticker intent
options.body: Expose action=sticker or an explicit WhatsApp send option and route media as stickers only when that intent is present.

options.title: Use WebP heuristics
options.body: Automatically treat qualifying WebP media as stickers, accepting misclassification risk for ordinary WebP image sends.

options.title: Defer public support
options.body: Keep the low-level helper and inbound sticker handling until a broader cross-channel sticker contract is chosen.

recommendation.title: Use explicit sticker intent
recommendation.body: Expose action=sticker or an explicit WhatsApp send option and route media as stickers only when that intent is present.

likelyOwner.reason: mcaxtr has the strongest recent history on the structured WhatsApp send helper that already emits a Baileys sticker payload.
